verdict.rationale: The open-source backend README documents a first-party opt-out for self-hosted deployments: the `--disable-beacon` flag on the backend binary. The phrasing "if you really want to disable it" implies the beacon is on by default, and nothing in the evidence covers telemetry opt-out for the CLI, the cloud service or the dashboard. Missing for 10: telemetry opt-out for the CLI and cloud-hosted usage, documentation of what the beacon collects, a dedicated privacy/telemetry docs page, and independent corroboration.
